headline: Petrol Hits New Record on Motorways: Nearly 2.20 Euros per Litre. Diesel Up to 2.29
summary: Petrol reached a new record on Italy's motorway network at nearly 2.20 euros per litre, while diesel rose to 2.29 euros, according to the latest data cited.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs, inflation and consumer spending. Refined fuel prices track crude oil and refining margins.
